name: NEW SWARNIMA (Gopalak Nigam)
briefDescription: Self-employment loan scheme for Rabari and Bharwad women in Gujarat, offering up to ₹2 lakh at 5% annual interest to promote economic independence.
descriptionMd:
The **New Swarnima Scheme** is a financial empowerment initiative by the **Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam** under the **Social Justice and Empowerment Department**. It aims to provide **100% loan** support to women from the **Rabari and Bharwad communities** to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship.
Eligible women between the **age of 21 and 45 years**, with an **annual family income up to ₹3 lakh**, can receive a **loan of up to ₹2 lakh** at a subsidized **interest rate of 5% per annum** to start a business of their choice. The scheme is designed to increase economic independence and livelihood generation among backward class women.
benefitsMd: - **100% loan** assistance provided to eligible women- Loan amount up to **₹2.00 lakh**- Interest rate fixed at **5% per annum**- Loan can be used to **start a business** of the beneficiary’s choice- Meant for **economically backward women** of specific castes- **Encourages entrepreneurship and self-reliance**
eligibilityMd: 1. Be a permanent **resident of Gujarat**1. Be a **woman**1. Belong to the **Rabari or Bharwad caste**1. Belong to a **socially and educationally backward class** as recognized by the Government of Gujarat1. Be between **21 to 45 years** of age1. Have a **total annual family** income not exceeding **₹3.00 lakh**1. Intend to start your **own business or self-employment** venture using the loan
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Visit the official [**DAADC**](https://daadconline.gujarat.gov.in/) online portal.
**Step 2:** **Register/log in** using your credentials.
**Step 3:** Fill out the application form with accurate personal and scheme-specific details.
**Step 4:** Upload the **required documents** and submit.
